LACEWORK_SCOPE.description: Optional assessment surface to query (hosts | containers | both). 'hosts' calls POST /api/v2/Vulnerabilities/Hosts/search; 'containers' calls POST /api/v2/Vulnerabilities/Containers/search; 'both' calls both (default). Synonyms tolerated: host -> hosts; container / image / images -> containers; all / any -> both. Whitespace and case-insensitive.

LACEWORK_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Optional minimum severity floor (info | low | medium | high | critical). Forwarded to Lacework as the severity in filter inside the Hosts / Containers search body (so the tenant only paginates results that survive the floor) AND enforced client-side after Faraday severity normalisation (handles Lacework's Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info enum and CVSS / cve_score base-score fallback). Defaults to info (no filtering).

name: lacework
title: Lacework (CNAPP)
description: Lacework Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP / CSPM) REST importer. Pulls cloud-security vulnerability findings from a Lacework tenant via the canonical POST /api/v2/Vulnerabilities/Hosts/search and POST /api/v2/Vulnerabilities/Containers/search endpoints and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Searches are paginated via paging.urls.nextPage cursor with severity in filter forwarded to the tenant (so only buckets that survive LACEWORK_MIN_SEVERITY are returned). Each affected machine (host scope — grouped by mid / machineTags.Hostname) or container image (container scope — grouped by imageId / evalCtx.image_info.repo) becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 ip because CNAPP findings live on cloud resources, not on IPs) with hostnames = {resourceName}@{mid|imageId}; per-resource findings attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per evalGuid (fallback to vulnId@feature@resource) with [CNAPP] engine prefix, '{vulnId} in {package}@{version} on {resource}' in the title, description / vuln_id / package / scope / cloud metadata (mid / hostname / region / cloud_provider / account / image_id / repo / registry / digest / image tags) / fix_available / fixed_version / first_seen / last_seen / status / severity / score / vector in the description; fixed_version surfaces as 'Upgrade {package} to {fixed_version}.' resolution (recommendation / remediation fallback). Refs include CWE-* (single + list + list-of-dict shapes with the CWE- prefix collapsed), 'Lacework-Vuln: {vulnId}' pivot label, finding.link / url / advisoryUrl, references / links URL shapes, and cveProps.link / references. CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from vulnId / cveId / name / title / description / aliases (string + list-of-string + list-of-dict shapes) plus cveProps.cve / cve_id / description (deduped case-insensitively). Severity normalised from Lacework's string enum (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info — also accepts Important / Major / Moderate / Minor / Information / None / Unspecified / Trivial / Negligible / Unknown) with CVSS v3 / v2 base-score bucketing as a fallback when only a numeric cvss_score / cveProps.cvss / score is given (<=0/>10 -> info, <4 low, <7 medium, <9 high, >=9 critical). Status mapped from finding.status (New / Active / Reopened -> open, Fixed / Resolved / VulnerabilityFixed / Patched / Remediated -> closed, Suppressed / Muted / WontFix / RiskAccepted / FalsePositive / Expired -> risk-accepted). Auth: Lacework uses an api-key / api-secret pair tied to a service account. The secret is sent as X-LW-UAKS: <api_secret> to /api/v2/access/tokens together with JSON body {keyId, expiryTime: 3600}; the response carries a short-lived bearer token (tolerated bare or wrapped under data[0]) that is then sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on subsequent calls. The tenant URL is derived from LACEWORK_ACCOUNT (bare subdomain -> https://<account>.lacework.net; a fully qualified URL is honoured as-is).
